subject: DI03000161

intro_text.en: Diagram-led study: seven Construction points and seven Working points for each detailed process or furnace.
intro_text.gu: Diagram સાથે દરેક detailed process/furnace માટે Construction ના 7 અને Working ના 7 points.

title.gu: 1.1 Casting ની સમજ અને Sand Moulding

h.en: 1.1.1 Casting: principle and complete manufacturing route

body.en:
Casting produces a component by introducing molten metal into a prepared cavity and allowing it to solidify. A sand mould is normally expendable; a permanent metal die can be reused. The mould cavity is not identical to the finished drawing: machining stock, contraction compensation, cores and feeding affect the design.

Route: interpret drawing → select process/alloy → prepare pattern and core equipment → make mould and cores → melt/condition metal → fill and solidify → shakeout/clean → inspect and finish. Each stage affects quality; merely filling a cavity is not the entire casting process.
body.gu:
Casting માં prepared cavity માં molten metal ભરી solidify થવા દઈ component બનાવીએ. Sand mould સામાન્ય રીતે expendable; metal die reusable. Cavity finished drawing જેવી જ હોતી નથી: machining stock, contraction, cores અને feeding ધ્યાનમાં લેવાય.

Drawing → process/alloy selection → pattern/core equipment → mould/cores → melting → filling/solidification → shakeout/cleaning → inspection/finishing. દરેક stage quality ને અસર કરે.

h.en: 1.1.2 Advantages, limitations and product selection

body.en:
Advantages: complex external/internal shapes; small to very large parts; many castable alloys; near-net shapes can reduce machining and assembly. Sand casting has relatively low tooling cost and flexible batch sizes.

Limitations: shrinkage/porosity risks, variable surface finish and accuracy, fettling/machining needs, process-specific minimum walls, tooling cost for high-production methods and hot-metal hazards. Cast material properties depend on alloy, soundness and heat treatment, not simply the process name. Typical products include pump bodies, engine blocks, machine beds, valve housings and complex precision parts. Select by geometry, alloy, quantity, tolerances and required integrity.
body.gu:
લાભ: complex બહાર/અંદરની shapes, નાનાંથી મોટા parts, ઘણી castable alloys, near-net shape થી machining/assembly ઘટાડો. Sand casting માં tooling cost relatively ઓછી અને batch flexibility.

મર્યાદા: shrinkage/porosity, finish/accuracy variation, fettling/machining, wall-thickness limits અને hot-metal hazards. Properties alloy,soundness,heat treatment પર પણ આધારિત. Pump bodies,engine blocks,machine beds,valves માટે વપરાય; geometry,alloy,quantity,tolerance,integrity મુજબ પસંદ કરો.

h.en: 1.1.3 Sand moulding: mould construction and full working cycle
h.gu: 1.1.3 Sand Moulding: Construction અને Full Working Cycle

body.en:
The pattern creates an expendable sand cavity; gates deliver metal, and a feeder supplies liquid as the casting contracts during solidification. Read the labelled section before following the sequence.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A flask contains the cope (upper half) and drag (lower half); locating pins maintain their relative alignment at the parting plane.
  2. The pattern represents casting geometry with necessary allowances and, where required, core prints; it is withdrawn before pouring.
  3. Moulding sand surrounds the pattern; its binder provides strength while controlled permeability allows gases to escape.
  4. The pouring basin, tapered sprue and sprue well receive metal and guide it toward the runner without an abrupt free-fall impact.
  5. Runner and ingates distribute metal into the cavity; runner extensions or suitable filters may help trap inclusions in a designed system.
  6. Cores occupy intended internal voids and sit in core-print seats; vents provide gas escape without intentionally becoming metal passages.
  7. Risers/feeders, flask restraints and any designed chills complete the feeding/support arrangement; these features are chosen for the actual casting.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Interpret the drawing and determine parting line, pattern allowance, core requirement, gating and feeding before preparing the mould.
  2. Place the drag and pattern on a moulding board; apply appropriate facing material and compact prepared sand uniformly around the pattern.
  3. Strike off and turn the drag; locate the cope, parting material and sprue/feeder formers, then fill and compact the cope.
  4. Separate the halves and carefully withdraw the pattern/formers; cut or finish runners and ingates and repair only by an approved method.
  5. Install correctly prepared cores, verify seats/vents and cavity cleanliness, then close and secure the aligned mould using the designed restraint.
  6. Qualified personnel introduce the specified metal under controlled foundry conditions; allow filling, feeding and sufficient solidification/cooling.
  7. After safe cooling, shake out, remove cores/gates/feeders, clean the casting and inspect dimensions/defects before machining or acceptance.

Applications, limitations and safety

Applications: general castings from prototypes to large iron/steel/non-ferrous parts. Finish and accuracy are usually below precision die/investment processes. These are study stages, not permission to handle molten metal without trained supervision.
body.gu:
Pattern sand માં cavity બનાવે; gates metal પહોંચાડે અને feeder solidification contraction દરમિયાન liquid આપે. પહેલાં labelled section વાંચો.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Flask માં upper cope અને lower drag હોય; locating pins parting plane પર બંને halves align રાખે.
  2. Pattern માં casting geometry, જરૂરી allowances અને core prints હોય; pouring પહેલાં pattern કાઢી લેવાય.
  3. Moulding sand pattern આસપાસ compact થાય; binder strength અને controlled permeability gas escape આપે.
  4. Pouring basin, tapered sprue અને well metal ને runner તરફ પહોંચાડી abrupt impact ઘટાડે.
  5. Runner/ingates metal cavity માં વહેંચે; designed extension/filter inclusions trap કરવામાં મદદ કરે.
  6. Cores intended hollow ભાગ occupy કરે અને core-print seats માં બેસે; vents gas માટે હોય, metal passage માટે નહિ.
  7. Feeders, restraints અને જરૂરી chills actual casting પ્રમાણે feeding/support arrangement પૂરું કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Drawing પરથી parting line, allowances, cores, gating અને feeding પહેલાં નક્કી કરો.
  2. Drag/pattern board પર રાખી suitable facing material અને prepared sand થી uniform compaction કરો.
  3. Strike-off/turn કર્યા પછી cope align કરી parting material અને sprue/feeder formers મૂકી sand compact કરો.
  4. Halves અલગ કરી pattern/formers carefully કાઢો; runners/ingates finish અને repair approved method પ્રમાણે.
  5. Prepared cores, seats,vents,cleanliness check કરી mould align/close અને designed restraints લગાડો.
  6. Qualified foundry personnel controlled conditions માં specified metal ભરે; filling,feeding,solidification/cooling થવા દો.
  7. Safe cooling પછી shakeout,core/gate/feeder removal,cleaning અને dimension/defect inspection કરો; પછી machining/acceptance.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

ઉપયોગ: prototype થી large iron/steel/non-ferrous castings. Precision die/investment કરતાં સામાન્ય finish/accuracy ઓછી. આ study stages છે; trained supervision વગર molten metal handle કરવાની સૂચના નથી.

h.en: 1.1.4 Solidification, feeding and the difference between gate and riser

body.en:
Metal first loses superheat, then releases latent heat while solidifying and finally contracts as the solid cools. A heavy junction may remain liquid after surrounding thin sections freeze, creating a hot spot. Directional solidification toward an effective feeder helps supply liquid where solidification shrinkage occurs.

A gate fills the cavity; a riser feeds contraction and should remain effective long enough to supply the connected region. A riser is not merely a vent or a decorative reservoir. Chills locally increase heat extraction; their location must be designed so they do not isolate an unfed hot spot. Pattern shrinkage allowance compensates solid-state dimensional contraction, not an internal shrinkage cavity.
body.gu:
Metal પહેલાં superheat ગુમાવે, પછી latent heat છોડીને solidify થાય અને solid cooling માં contract થાય. Heavy junction hot spot બની thin walls પછી freeze થાય. Effective feeder તરફ directional solidification feeding માટે મદદરૂપ.

Gate filling માટે; riser contraction feed માટે. Riser ફક્ત vent નહિ. Chill local cooling વધારે પણ unfed hot spot isolate ન કરે તે design જોઈએ. Pattern shrinkage allowance solid-state dimensional contraction માટે છે, internal shrinkage cavity માટે નહિ.

h.en: 1.2.1 Pattern: definition, materials and choice

body.en:
A pattern is the tool used to form the mould cavity, including necessary geometry allowances and print features. It is not the final casting and not always a solid copy of the finished component. Core boxes form cores; patterns form the surrounding mould.

Wood is light, economical and easily modified but can wear/absorb moisture. Aluminium and other metal patterns suit repeated production with better durability but higher cost. Plastics/resins can give stable smooth tooling; wax is expendable in investment casting. Choose by batch size, required accuracy, shape complexity, withdrawal and storage conditions.
body.gu:
Pattern mould cavity બનાવવાનું tool છે, જેમાં allowances/prints હોય. તે finished casting નથી; હંમેશાં finished component ની solid copy પણ નથી. Core box core બનાવે, pattern surrounding mould બનાવે.

Wood economical/light/modifiable પણ wear/moisture problem. Metal patterns durable repeated production માટે પણ initial cost વધુ. Resin/plastic stable smooth tooling; wax investment માં expendable. Quantity,accuracy,shape,withdrawal,storage મુજબ પસંદ કરો.

h.en: 1.2.2 Pattern types: single, split, multi-piece and loose-piece
h.gu: 1.2.2 Pattern Types: Single, Split, Multi-piece અને Loose-piece

body.en:
Single-piece: simple shapes withdrawn in one direction without dividing the tool. Split/two-piece: halves locate on a parting plane, easing moulding of more complex forms. Multi-piece: extra divisions permit withdrawal where two halves are insufficient.

Loose-piece patterns have detachable projections to release undercuts; first withdraw the main body, then remove the loose piece through the available cavity path without damaging sand. Loose parts need reliable location during ramming. Select type by withdrawal geometry, not just part size. More pieces can improve access but add alignment and handling errors.
body.gu:
Single-piece simple shape એક direction માં withdraw થાય. Split/two-piece માં parting plane પર located halves; multi-piece માં વધારાના divisions થી difficult shape withdraw થાય.

Loose-piece માં undercut projection detachable હોય: main body પછી loose piece યોગ્ય path થી કાઢો જેથી sand તૂટે નહિ. Ramming દરમિયાન reliable location જરૂરી. Type withdrawal geometry પરથી પસંદ કરો; વધુ pieces alignment/handling errors પણ વધારી શકે.

h.en: 1.2.3 Production pattern types and special arrangements

body.en:
Match-plate patterns carry cope and drag halves on opposite faces of one plate; gates may be incorporated for repeatable machine moulding. Cope-and-drag patterns use separate plates for the two halves, useful for larger tooling. Gated patterns join several patterns through a common gating arrangement.

Sweep patterns form large axisymmetric cavities by sweeping a shaped template. Skeleton patterns are open frameworks finished with sand, useful for large low-quantity castings. Segmental patterns repeat a portion to produce a full circular mould. Follow-board patterns use a supporting board for fragile/irregular shapes. Explain how each arrangement reduces tooling or withdrawal difficulty.
body.gu:
Match-plate માં એક plate ની opposite sides પર cope/drag halves; gates included હોઈ શકે. Cope-and-drag માં અલગ plates, મોટા tooling માટે. Gated pattern multiple parts ને common gating થી જોડે.

Sweep shaped template ફેરવી axisymmetric cavity બનાવે; skeleton open framework sand થી finish થાય; segmental portion repeat કરીને circular mould; follow-board irregular/fragile pattern ને support આપે. નામ સાથે arrangement નો હેતુ સમજવો.

h.en: 1.2.4 Six important pattern allowances

body.en:
Shrinkage/contraction allowance is normally positive for the expected solid-state metal contraction; use the specified alloy/process rule. Machining allowance leaves stock only on surfaces to be finished. Draft tapers withdrawal faces to avoid tearing sand; inside faces often need more than outside faces.

Distortion/camber allowance deliberately compensates predictable warpage. Rapping/shake allowance is commonly negative because loosening the pattern enlarges the cavity. Mould-wall movement allowance may compensate cavity enlargement under heat/pressure, and is process-dependent. Not all allowances are simply added as positive millimetres, and core prints are not a seventh size allowance.
body.gu:
Shrinkage સામાન્ય રીતે positive, specified alloy/process rule મુજબ. Machining stock ફક્ત finish કરવાની surfaces પર. Draft withdrawal faces taper કરે જેથી sand ન તૂટે; inside draft ઘણીવાર વધુ.

Distortion/camber predictable warpage ને compensate કરે. Rapping/shake સામાન્ય રીતે negative, કારણ loosening cavity મોટું કરે. Mould-wall movement allowance process-dependent cavity enlargement compensate કરે. બધાં allowances positive mm તરીકે ઉમેરવા નહિ; core print size allowance નથી.

h.en: 1.2.5 Solved allowance example: external block and the percentage basis
h.gu: 1.2.5 Solved Allowance: External Block અને Percentage Basis

body.en:
Required finished block length=200 mm; machining stock=3 mm on EACH end. Intended cooled as-cast length before machining=200+2×3=206 mm. Assume a foundry rule of1% added to the required cooled casting dimension: pattern length=206×1.01=208.06 mm.

If the question instead defines contraction as exactly1% of the original pattern/hot reference length, use Lcold=.99 Lpattern, giving Lpattern=206/.99=208.0808 mm. These conventions differ slightly. State which one is given; do not silently treat them as identical. No rapping or distortion allowance is included in this example.
body.gu:
Finished length200mm, EACH end stock3mm → cooled as-cast length206mm. Foundry rule required cooled dimension પર1% addition હોય તો pattern206×1.01=208.06mm.

જો contraction original pattern/hot-reference length ના exactly1% તરીકે define હોય તો Lcold=.99Lpattern →206/.99=208.0808mm. બંને conventions થોડાં અલગ. Given basis લખો; rapping/distortion અહીં included નથી.

h.en: 1.2.6 Internal holes, core dimensions and draft calculation
h.gu: 1.2.6 Internal Hole, Core Dimensions અને Draft Calculation

body.en:
For a finished bored hole diameter50 mm with2 mm radial machining stock on its bore wall, the required cooled as-cast hole is50−2×2=46 mm. Adding stock makes the as-cast hole SMALLER, opposite to an outside diameter. This46 mm is a casting target, not automatically the final core-box size; core expansion, alloy contraction and restraint require the specified core rule.

Draft on one face of height100 mm at1° gives lateral offset=100 tan1°=1.746 mm. If both opposite faces flare by1°, their width difference is2×1.746=3.491 mm. Mark the withdrawal direction and which end dimension is specified.
body.gu:
Finished bored hole50mm અને bore wall પર radial stock2mm હોય તો cooled as-cast hole50−4=46mm. Stock ઉમેરતાં hole નાનું થાય, external diameter ની વિપરીત. આ casting target છે; final core-box size માટે expansion/contraction/restraint rule જોઈએ.

Height100mm,draft1° માટે એક face offset100tan1°=1.746mm. બંને opposite faces flare તો width difference3.491mm. Withdrawal direction અને specified end બતાવો.

h.en: 1.2.7 Cores: need, types, properties and chaplets
h.gu: 1.2.7 Cores: Need, Types, Properties અને Chaplets

body.en:
Cores form internal passages, cavities or recesses that the pattern alone cannot leave by withdrawal. Horizontal, vertical, balanced, hanging and cover-core arrangements describe orientation/support; dry-sand, shell and chemically bonded cores describe material/process. Use the correct classification basis.

Core sand needs strength for handling and metal buoyancy, refractoriness, gas escape and collapsibility for casting contraction/removal. Core prints create locating seats; they are not the core itself. Chaplets are designed metal supports used only when print support is insufficient; compatibility, cleanliness and fusion are critical. Poor support causes core shift, wrong wall thickness or exposure of a required passage.
body.gu:
Core pattern withdrawal થી ન બની શકતા internal passages/cavities/recesses બનાવે. Horizontal,vertical,balanced,hanging,cover support/orientation types; dry-sand,shell,chemical bonded material/process types. Classification basis સ્પષ્ટ રાખો.

Handling/buoyancy માટે strength,heat માટે refractoriness,gas escape અને collapse/removal જરૂરી. Core print locating seat બનાવે; core નથી. Chaplets insufficient support માટે designed metal supports; compatibility/cleanliness/fusion જરૂરી. Core shift wall thickness/passages બગાડે.

title.en: 1.3 Moulding sand, gating and mould-making equipment

h.en: 1.3.1 Sand types and binder systems

body.en:
Green sand is used in the moist, undried condition; “green” does not describe its colour. Dry-sand moulds are dried before use. Facing sand contacts the metal; backing sand fills the remaining flask. System sand is circulated as a controlled general mix; parting sand/material helps separate surfaces. Core sand is formulated for core making.

Silica is common, with alternatives selected for special thermal/chemical requirements. Clay/bentonite with controlled moisture is a common green-sand binder system. Oil/resin, sodium-silicate and other chemical systems suit selected mould/core processes. Binders are not interchangeable without curing, gas-generation and reclamation considerations.
body.gu:
Green sand moist/undried condition માં વપરાય; green colour નહિ. Dry-sand mould use પહેલાં dry થાય. Facing metal ને touch કરે; backing બાકી flask ભરે; system controlled circulating mix; parting separation માટે; core sand ખાસ core માટે.

Silica common, special thermal/chemical જરૂર મુજબ alternatives. Clay/bentonite+controlled moisture green-sand binder. Oil/resin,sodium-silicate/chemical systems specific processes માટે. Curing,gas,reclamation વિચાર્યા વગર binder બદલી ન શકાય.

h.en: 1.3.2 Sand properties: balance strength against gas escape
h.gu: 1.3.2 Sand Properties: Strength અને Gas Escape નું Balance

body.en:
Refractoriness resists high temperature; permeability permits gas flow; green/dry/hot strength prevents mould damage at relevant stages. Flowability/compactability allow uniform packing around detail. Cohesiveness binds grains, while adhesiveness helps sand adhere where needed.

Fineness improves surface detail but may reduce permeability. Collapsibility allows cooling contraction and easier shakeout. Excessive moisture can generate gas; excessive compaction can restrict escape; too little strength causes erosion/inclusions. A useful sand mix balances properties for the alloy and section size rather than maximizing any one property. Testing and controlled reuse matter as much as the initial recipe.
body.gu:
Refractoriness heat resist; permeability gas escape; green/dry/hot strength respective stages માં mould સાચવે. Flowability/compactability detail આસપાસ packing; cohesiveness grains bind; adhesiveness જરૂરી surface પર adhesion.

Fine grains detail સુધારે પણ permeability ઘટાડી શકે. Collapsibility contraction/shakeout માટે. Excess moisture gas,over-compaction escape ઘટાડે,low strength erosion આપે. Alloy/section પ્રમાણે properties balance કરવી; એક property maximum કરવી નહિ. Testing/reuse control જરૂરી.

h.en: 1.3.3 Gating components and their individual functions

body.en:
Pouring basin receives the stream and reduces entry turbulence. A downward-tapered sprue helps the accelerating stream run full, reducing aspiration when properly designed. A sprue well reduces impact at the direction change. Runner distributes flow; ingates connect it to the casting. Runner extension and suitable filters can help intercept slag/inclusions.

A riser is primarily a FEEDING component even when its position also reveals filling. Vents release gas rather than meter the main metal flow. Good design balances filling time, erosion, oxidation, air entrainment and premature freezing; merely enlarging every gate does not guarantee soundness.
body.gu:
Pouring basin stream receive/turbulence ઘટાડે. Proper downward-tapered sprue accelerating stream full રાખી aspiration ઘટાડે. Sprue well direction-change impact ઘટાડે; runner distribute અને ingates cavity સાથે જોડે. Extension/filter inclusions રોકવામાં મદદ કરે.

Riser મુખ્યત્વે FEEDING component; vents gas માટે. Filling time,erosion,oxidation,air entrainment,premature freezing balance કરો. બધાં gates મોટા કરવાથી soundness guaranteed નહિ.

h.en: 1.3.4 Gating types, ratio, merits and limitations
h.gu: 1.3.4 Gating Types, Ratio, Merits અને Limitations

body.en:
By entry location: top gating fills from above but can erode/splash; bottom gating fills more quietly upward but may have longer flow paths and thermal loss; parting-line gating is convenient for many split moulds but still needs controlled entry.

Gating ratio is sprue area:TOTAL runner area:TOTAL ingate area. A pressurised arrangement restricts downstream area to run fuller but can increase velocity/turbulence; an unpressurised arrangement expands area to reduce entry velocity but can leave partly filled passages if poorly designed. Illustrative ratios1:.75:.5 and1:2:2 are not universal alloy rules. Identify the choke and use the specified foundry design method.
body.gu:
Entry location મુજબ top gating ઉપરથી fill કરે પણ splash/erosion; bottom quiet upward filling પણ longer path/thermal loss; parting-line convenient પણ controlled entry જરૂરી.

Ratio=sprue area:TOTAL runner area:TOTAL ingate area. Pressurised downstream restriction fuller flow આપે પણ velocity/turbulence વધારે; unpressurised expansion velocity ઘટાડે પણ poor design માં passages partly filled.1:.75:.5 અને1:2:2 examples છે, universal alloy rule નહિ. Choke ઓળખો.

h.en: 1.3.5 Moulding hand tools and safe use
h.gu: 1.3.5 Moulding Hand Tools અને Safe Use

body.en:
Riddle screens lumps; shovel handles sand; rammer compacts it; strike-off bar levels the flask. Vent wire makes gas passages without puncturing the mould cavity unnecessarily. Trowel/slick finish and repair accessible surfaces; lifter reaches deeper areas; draw spike assists pattern withdrawal. A swab may condition the draw edge where the sand process permits it.

Tools must be clean, suitable and used without over-ramming or damaging detail. Do not treat adding moisture near live molten metal as a normal correction step. Dust control, good housekeeping and safe lifting are required even when the workpiece is cold.
body.gu:
Riddle lumps screen કરે; shovel sand માટે; rammer compaction; strike-off levelling. Vent wire gas passages માટે, cavity અનાવશ્યક puncture નહિ. Trowel/slick finish/repair, lifter deep areas, draw spike withdrawal. Process permit કરે ત્યાં swab draw edge condition કરે.

Clean suitable tools લો; over-ram/detail damage નહિ. Live molten metal પાસે moisture ઉમેરવું correction નથી. Cold work માં પણ dust control,housekeeping,safe lifting જરૂરી.

h.en: 1.3.6 Mould-making machine: squeeze arrangement

body.en:
A squeeze machine compacts sand by controlled pressure between a head and a supported pattern/flask assembly. Jolt, jolt-squeeze and sand-slinger alternatives use different compaction actions.

Construction — 7 points

  1. The rigid frame supports the squeeze head and table, maintaining their alignment through the compaction stroke.
  2. The table or platen carries the pattern plate; suitable support prevents tooling deflection under the applied force.
  3. A flask locates on the pattern plate and contains the sand above and around the pattern geometry.
  4. The squeeze head/board contacts the prepared sand surface and distributes the applied compaction force.
  5. A hydraulic or pneumatic actuator supplies the controlled motion; its system includes rated pressure-control components.
  6. Pattern-stripping/lifting features separate mould and tooling without tearing the compacted cavity.
  7. Guards, interlocks, controls and dust-management provisions protect operators from crushing points and sand exposure.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Identify the tooling, compaction method and safe loading position from the approved machine setup.
  2. Locate the pattern plate and flask; prepare the sand fill consistently so density is not governed by random loading.
  3. Bring the guarded squeeze head and supported assembly into their designed working relationship.
  4. Apply the specified controlled stroke/load so sand compacts around the pattern; do not infer settings from this schematic.
  5. Release the compaction load and return the mechanism to its safe withdrawal position.
  6. Strip the mould using the machine provision, then inspect edges, cavity integrity and achieved compaction.
  7. Transfer the mould for core setting/closing as required; clean and inspect tooling only in the prescribed isolated state.

Applications, limitations and safety

Squeeze moulding improves repeatability for suitable tooling but may compact non-uniformly around deep or complex shapes. Jolt uses repeated table impacts; jolt-squeeze combines actions; a sand slinger projects sand into the flask. Each needs its own safeguards and settings.
body.gu:
Squeeze machine માં head અને supported pattern/flask વચ્ચે controlled pressure થી sand compact થાય. Jolt/jolt-squeeze/sand-slinger નું action અલગ છે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Rigid frame head/table align રાખે અને compaction force વહન કરે.
  2. Table/platen pattern plate support કરે; tooling deflection ન થાય તે support જોઈએ.
  3. Flask pattern plate પર locate થઈ geometry આસપાસ sand રાખે.
  4. Squeeze head/board surface પર contact કરી compaction load distribute કરે.
  5. Hydraulic/pneumatic actuator controlled stroke આપે; rated pressure controls જરૂરી.
  6. Stripping/lifting features tooling અને mould tear વગર અલગ કરે.
  7. Guards,interlocks,controls,dust management crush/sand exposure hazards ઘટાડે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Approved setup થી tooling,method અને safe loading position ઓળખો.
  2. Pattern/flask locate કરી consistent sand fill કરો જેથી random density variation ન થાય.
  3. Guarded head અને supported assembly designed working position માં લાવો.
  4. Specified stroke/load થી compaction; diagram પરથી operating settings ન નક્કી કરો.
  5. Load release કરી mechanism safe withdrawal position માં પરત લાવો.
  6. Machine provision થી mould strip કરી cavity/edges/compaction inspect કરો.
  7. Core setting/closing માટે transfer; cleaning/inspection prescribed isolation પછી જ.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Suitable tooling માટે repeatability વધે, પણ deep/complex shapes માં density nonuniform હોઈ શકે. Jolt repeated impacts; jolt-squeeze combined; sand slinger projected sand. દરેક machine માટે અલગ safeguards/settings જોઈએ.

h.en: 1.4.1 Furnace selection and overlapping classifications

body.en:
Select a melting unit by alloy compatibility, required melt temperature, batch/continuous output, atmosphere, contamination, energy supply, temperature control and handling method. A furnace that melts aluminium economically is not automatically suitable for steel.

“Crucible” describes a separate vessel holding metal; “pit” describes a below-floor arrangement; “electric” describes the heat source. Therefore these categories can overlap: a pit installation may hold a crucible, and a crucible can be heated electrically. The following individual diagrams show representative arrangements, not mutually exclusive definitions. Cupolas are predominantly used for cast iron; operating one for an arbitrary alloy is not assumed.
body.gu:
Alloy compatibility,temperature,output,atmosphere,contamination,energy,control અને handling પરથી furnace પસંદ કરો. Aluminium માટે suitable furnace steel માટે automatically suitable નથી.

Crucible અલગ metal-holding vessel; pit below-floor arrangement; electric heat source. એટલે categories overlap: pit માં crucible અને crucible electric-heated હોઈ શકે. નીચે representative arrangements છે. Cupola મુખ્યત્વે cast iron માટે; arbitrary alloy માનવું નહિ.

h.en: 1.4.2 Crucible furnace: fuel-fired representative type

body.en:
Heat from fuel combustion passes through the crucible wall into the charge. The vessel separates the metal from direct contact with the fuel bed/flue stream.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A steel casing provides the outer mechanical support; it is not the hot-face material directly containing combustion gases.
  2. Refractory lining and insulation surround the heating chamber to withstand temperature and reduce heat loss.
  3. A compatible crucible holds the metal charge; its material must resist the alloy, temperature and handling cycle.
  4. A refractory pedestal/base supports the crucible with clearance around it for the heating gases.
  5. A burner and controlled air supply introduce heat into the chamber; electric alternatives use another source and are classified separately here.
  6. A lid and designed flue opening contain heat while permitting the required combustion-gas discharge.
  7. Rated lifting tongs/shank or a tilting mechanism, plus temperature-measurement provisions, support controlled transfer and monitoring.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified staff verify vessel condition, lining, dry compatible charge and the approved furnace readiness checks before heating.
  2. The crucible is correctly supported and the heating system operates according to its established controlled procedure.
  3. Combustion gases circulate around the vessel, transferring heat through its wall rather than being injected through the bath.
  4. The charge absorbs heat, reaches melting conditions and forms a liquid bath; temperature and alloy condition are monitored.
  5. Any composition adjustment, treatment or dross/slag removal follows the alloy-specific approved practice, not an improvised addition.
  6. The melt is transferred by the rated lifting/tilting system into a prepared compatible ladle or mould under trained control.
  7. After transfer, the equipment follows its controlled shutdown/cooling routine and is inspected before the next service cycle.

Applications, limitations and safety

Common for small batches of suitable non-ferrous alloys and selected specialised melts. It is simple and flexible but vessel life, batch capacity, energy losses and contamination control limit the choice. Moisture, damaged crucibles and unsuitable tools create severe hazards.
body.gu:
Fuel combustion ની heat crucible wall મારફતે charge સુધી જાય. Crucible metal ને direct fuel/flue-stream contact થી અલગ રાખે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Steel casing outer support આપે; hot gases માટે hot-face lining અલગ છે.
  2. Refractory/insulation heat withstand અને losses ઘટાડે.
  3. Compatible crucible charge રાખે; alloy,temperature,handling cycle માટે material suitable હોવું જોઈએ.
  4. Refractory pedestal crucible support કરી gases માટે આસપાસ clearance આપે.
  5. Burner/controlled air chamber માં heat આપે; electric alternative અલગ heat source છે.
  6. Lid અને designed flue heat contain કરી combustion gases બહાર કાઢે.
  7. Rated tongs/shank અથવા tilt mechanism તથા temperature measurement controlled transfer/monitoring માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified staff vessel,lining,dry compatible charge અને readiness checks કરે.
  2. Crucible correctly support કરીને approved controlled heating procedure અનુસરાય.
  3. Gases crucible આસપાસ ફરે; wall મારફતે heat આપે, bath માં gas inject નહિ.
  4. Charge heat absorb કરી melt થાય; temperature/alloy condition monitor થાય.
  5. Treatment,composition adjustment,dross removal alloy-specific approved practice મુજબ, improvised additions નહિ.
  6. Rated lift/tilt થી compatible prepared ladle/mould માં trained control હેઠળ transfer.
  7. Controlled shutdown/cooling પછી equipment inspect કરી આગામી cycle માટે તૈયાર.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Suitable non-ferrous small batches/special melts માટે. Simple/flexible પણ crucible life,capacity,energy loss,contamination મર્યાદા. Moisture,damaged crucibles,unsuitable tools ગંભીર hazards છે.

h.en: 1.4.3 Pit furnace: below-floor crucible arrangement

body.en:
A pit furnace places much of the heating chamber below workshop floor level. The illustrated type heats a crucible; the pit layout is not itself a separate metallurgical heat-transfer principle.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A below-floor pit and engineered foundation support the furnace, allowing the top opening to lie near floor level.
  2. A refractory-lined chamber contains the hot zone and protects the surrounding structural enclosure.
  3. A compatible crucible sits on a stable refractory support, with space for effective heating circulation.
  4. A burner/fuel-air passage supplies heat in the shown type; other pit installations may use different heating systems.
  5. A removable/operated insulated cover limits heat loss and protects the access opening during normal service.
  6. A designed flue and ventilation route remove combustion products without exposing the work area to uncontrolled emissions.
  7. Lifting access, opening guards, dry drainage management and handling clearances address the special hazards of a floor-level pit.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Before the cycle, authorised staff check the pit area, dry surroundings, vessel/support integrity and safe handling route.
  2. The compatible charge and crucible are prepared by the approved procedure, without introducing wet material into a hot system.
  3. With the cover and heat source in their designed operating condition, heat circulates through the lined chamber.
  4. The crucible transfers this heat to the charge until it becomes the required liquid alloy.
  5. Temperature/composition and the condition of the melt are monitored using suitable instruments and approved treatment practice.
  6. The cover is operated and the vessel lifted or metal transferred using the designed handling system and exclusion zone.
  7. The pit is secured during controlled cooling/shutdown; lining, crucible and access protection are checked before reuse.

Applications, limitations and safety

Useful where suitable crucible capacity and floor-level handling fit the foundry layout. It can conserve floor space above ground but adds pit-access, moisture, ventilation and lifting risks. A pit must not collect water where molten metal could enter.
body.gu:
Pit furnace નું chamber મોટાભાગે floor નીચે હોય. અહીં crucible-heated type છે; pit layout પોતે અલગ metallurgical principle નથી.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Engineered pit/foundation floor નીચે chamber support કરે; top opening floor નજીક હોય.
  2. Refractory chamber hot zone contain કરી enclosure protect કરે.
  3. Compatible crucible stable refractory support પર; heat circulation clearance રહે.
  4. Shown type માં burner/fuel-air passage; અન્ય pit types ની heating અલગ હોઈ શકે.
  5. Insulated cover heat loss ઘટાડે અને opening protect કરે.
  6. Designed flue/ventilation combustion products safely route કરે.
  7. Lifting access,opening guards,dry drainage અને clearances floor-level pit hazards માટે જરૂરી.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Authorised staff pit area,dry surroundings,support/vessel અને handling route check કરે.
  2. Approved procedure થી charge/crucible તૈયાર; hot system માં wet material નહિ.
  3. Cover/heat source designed condition માં રાખતાં lined chamber માં heat circulate થાય.
  4. Crucible મારફતે charge heat મેળવી required liquid alloy બને.
  5. Suitable instruments થી temperature/composition અને approved treatment monitor થાય.
  6. Designed handling/exclusion zone થી cover operation,vessel lifting/transfer થાય.
  7. Controlled cooling/shutdown દરમિયાન pit secure; reuse પહેલાં lining/crucible/access protection check.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Suitable crucible capacity/layout માટે ઉપયોગી. Above-ground obstruction ઓછું પણ pit access,moisture,ventilation,lifting risks વધારે. Molten metal પહોંચી શકે ત્યાં pit માં water collect ન થવું જોઈએ.

h.en: 1.4.4 Electric resistance furnace: indirect crucible type

body.en:
Electrical resistance elements generate Joule heat, which reaches the charge through the furnace atmosphere and crucible wall. This is indirect heating, not an electric arc.

Construction — 7 points

  1. An outer casing and insulated refractory chamber provide structural support and thermal containment.
  2. Resistance elements mounted in suitable positions convert electrical input to heat while remaining within their temperature rating.
  3. A compatible crucible or retort contains the charge; the illustrated elements do not pass current through the metal itself.
  4. An insulated lid/door closes the working opening and limits radiative/convective loss.
  5. A rated power supply, switching/control equipment and electrical protection deliver controlled energy to the elements.
  6. Temperature sensors and a controller regulate the chamber/melt according to the process requirement; sensor position matters.
  7. Handling provisions, interlocks, earthing and element protection support safe loading and prevent access to live/hot parts.

Working — 7 steps

  1. The approved dry load and compatible vessel are checked along with elements, protection and temperature instrumentation.
  2. Authorised operation applies controlled electrical input to the resistance elements after the enclosure is correctly secured.
  3. Element resistance produces heat; radiation/convection and the vessel wall transfer it to the charge.
  4. The charge heats and melts while the controller adjusts electrical input toward the specified condition.
  5. The melt temperature and any required holding/treatment are verified; chamber readings are not assumed identical to bath temperature.
  6. The melt is transferred with rated equipment under the authorised hot-metal procedure, isolated from exposed electrical hazards.
  7. The furnace follows its prescribed cooling/isolation routine before element, lining or electrical inspection and maintenance.

Applications, limitations and safety

Provides clean point-of-use heating and good control for suitable melting/holding duties. Element limits, atmosphere compatibility and power supply affect suitability. “Electric” does not mean zero environmental impact; that also depends on the electricity source.
body.gu:
Resistance elements Joule heat બનાવે; atmosphere/crucible wall મારફતે charge સુધી જાય. આ indirect heating છે, electric arc નહિ.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Casing/insulated refractory chamber support અને heat containment આપે.
  2. Rated resistance elements electrical input ને heat માં ફેરવે.
  3. Compatible crucible/retort charge રાખે; shown type માં current metal માંથી સીધો પસાર થતો નથી.
  4. Insulated lid/door working opening બંધ કરી losses ઘટાડે.
  5. Rated supply,switching,controls,protection energy deliver કરે.
  6. Temperature sensors/controller process મુજબ regulation કરે; sensor position અગત્યનું.
  7. Handling,interlocks,earthing,element protection live/hot access અટકાવે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Approved dry load,vessel,elements,protection,instruments check થાય.
  2. Enclosure secure કર્યા પછી authorised operation controlled electrical input આપે.
  3. Resistance heat radiation/convection અને vessel wall મારફતે charge ને મળે.
  4. Controller input adjust કરતાં charge heat/melt થાય.
  5. Bath temperature/holding/treatment verify કરો; chamber reading=metal temperature માનવું નહિ.
  6. Rated transfer equipment અને authorised procedure થી electrical/hot-metal hazards અલગ રાખો.
  7. Prescribed cooling/isolation પછી જ element,lining,electrical inspection/maintenance.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Suitable melting/holding માટે clean point-of-use heat અને control. Element limits,atmosphere,power supply suitability નક્કી કરે. Electric એટલે zero environmental impact નહિ; electricity source પણ અગત્યનું.

h.en: 1.4.5 Coreless induction furnace

body.en:
Alternating current in a surrounding coil creates a changing magnetic field. Induced currents in the conductive charge generate heat; electromagnetic action also tends to stir the bath.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A mechanically supported shell contains a refractory-lined crucible-shaped bath; lining separates the metal from the coil.
  2. A copper induction coil surrounds the bath region and carries high alternating current.
  3. A dedicated power-conversion/supply system provides the electrical frequency and power required by the designed furnace.
  4. An engineered closed cooling circuit removes coil/electrical heat; it is physically separated from the metal bath by sound construction.
  5. A lid or cover and appropriate fume-extraction arrangement reduce losses/exposure for the designed operation.
  6. A tilting or other rated pouring arrangement transfers metal without improvised lifting of the furnace body.
  7. Temperature, cooling, electrical and lining-condition monitoring/protection detect unsafe conditions before a breach or electrical fault.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Authorised checks verify dry compatible charge, lining integrity, cooling/protection status and the charging plan.
  2. The approved charge is positioned without bridging or trapped sealed containers, according to the furnace-specific safe procedure.
  3. Alternating coil current produces magnetic flux that induces currents in the conductive charge.
  4. Electrical resistance within the charge generates heat, progressively melting it; electromagnetic forces circulate the liquid.
  5. Qualified staff monitor temperature/composition and apply only approved additions/treatment while respecting the electrical/cooling safeguards.
  6. The designed tilt/transfer system delivers the conditioned melt into a compatible prepared receiving vessel or mould.
  7. After the cycle, prescribed shutdown/cooling monitoring continues as required, followed by authorised lining and system inspection.

Applications, limitations and safety

Used for many ferrous/non-ferrous melting duties when the design is compatible. Good control and no direct fuel contact are advantages; lining condition, electrical supply, charge behaviour and cooling integrity are critical limits. A cooling leak near molten metal is a severe emergency, not a routine student adjustment.
body.gu:
Coil માં AC changing magnetic field બનાવે. Conductive charge માં induced currents heat આપે અને electromagnetic action bath stir કરે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Supported shell માં refractory-lined bath; lining metal ને coil થી અલગ રાખે.
  2. Copper induction coil bath આસપાસ high AC વહન કરે.
  3. Dedicated conversion/supply designed frequency/power આપે.
  4. Engineered closed cooling circuit coil/electrical heat દૂર કરે; sound structure થી metal bath થી અલગ રહે.
  5. Cover અને suitable fume extraction losses/exposure ઘટાડે.
  6. Rated tilt/pouring arrangement controlled transfer માટે.
  7. Temperature,cooling,electrical,lining monitoring unsafe conditions શોધે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Dry compatible charge,lining,cooling/protection અને charging plan authorised રીતે check.
  2. Furnace-specific procedure મુજબ charge મૂકો; bridging/sealed containers નહિ.
  3. Coil AC magnetic flux બનાવી conductive charge માં currents induce કરે.
  4. Charge resistance heat આપે અને melt થાય; electromagnetic forces liquid circulate કરે.
  5. Temperature/composition monitor તથા approved treatment/additions જ; electrical/cooling safeguards જાળવો.
  6. Designed tilt/transfer થી prepared compatible vessel/mould માં melt પહોંચે.
  7. Prescribed shutdown/cooling monitoring પછી authorised lining/system inspection.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Compatible designs માં ferrous/non-ferrous melting માટે. Good control/no direct fuel contact લાભ; lining,power,charge behaviour,cooling integrity અગત્યની મર્યાદા. Metal નજીક cooling leak severe emergency છે, student adjustment નહિ.

h.en: 1.4.6 Electric arc furnace

body.en:
An electrical arc provides intense heat between electrodes and the charge/bath in the representative direct-arc arrangement. The electrode system is distinct from an induction coil or resistance element.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A robust steel shell supports the refractory-lined hearth and sidewalls containing the metal/slag bath.
  2. A removable or movable roof closes the vessel and supports electrode entry openings in the illustrated design.
  3. Graphite electrodes extend toward the charge and are held by current-carrying arms/clamps.
  4. A rated transformer/power system supplies high current while the electrode-control mechanism maintains the designed arc condition.
  5. A charging provision introduces approved metallic charge; door/opening arrangements support authorised observation and slag practice.
  6. A tap hole/spout and tilting or tapping system transfer metal; slag handling has a separately designed provision.
  7. Off-gas extraction, monitoring, cooling where designed and electrical interlocks address fumes, intense radiation and fault hazards.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Approved charge, lining, electrodes, electrical protection and extraction are checked by qualified furnace personnel.
  2. The designated charging system loads the vessel and the roof/electrode assembly is secured for its operating mode.
  3. The controlled electrode/power system establishes arcs with the charge or molten bath.
  4. Arc radiation and heat transfer melt the charge; current and electrode position are regulated rather than manually improvised.
  5. The melt is monitored and refined/conditioned as required; slag practice and additions follow the alloy-specific authorised route.
  6. After the desired temperature/composition is achieved, the designed tapping system transfers metal while slag carryover is controlled.
  7. Controlled shutdown and inspection address refractory wear, electrode condition, off-gas and electrical systems before the next cycle.

Applications, limitations and safety

Common in steelmaking and selected foundry operations. High-temperature capability and flexible metallic charge are useful, but capital cost, electrode consumption, noise, dust, power quality and intense exposure require control. The diagram omits detailed refining/cooling construction.
body.gu:
Representative direct-arc type માં electrodes અને charge/bath વચ્ચે arc intense heat આપે. આ induction coil/resistance element થી અલગ છે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Steel shell refractory hearth/sidewalls support કરી metal/slag bath contain કરે.
  2. Movable roof vessel close કરે અને electrode entry openings આપે.
  3. Graphite electrodes current-carrying arms/clamps થી held હોય.
  4. Transformer/power supply high current આપે; electrode control designed arc condition જાળવે.
  5. Approved charge માટે charging provision અને observation/slag openings હોય.
  6. Tap/spout તથા tilt/tapping metal transfer કરે; slag માટે designed handling.
  7. Off-gas extraction,monitoring,designed cooling અને electrical interlocks જરૂરી.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified personnel charge,lining,electrodes,protection,extraction check કરે.
  2. Designated system vessel charge કરી roof/electrodes operating mode માટે secure કરે.
  3. Controlled power/electrodes charge અથવા bath સાથે arc establish કરે.
  4. Arc heat charge melt કરે; current/electrode position regulated, improvised manual નહિ.
  5. Melt monitor અને alloy-specific authorised slag/refining/additions થાય.
  6. Required temperature/composition પછી designed tapping થી metal transfer; slag carryover control.
  7. Shutdown/inspection માં refractory,electrodes,off-gas,electrical systems તપાસાય.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Steelmaking/selected foundries માં ઉપયોગ. High temperature અને flexible charge લાભ, પણ capital,electrodes,noise,dust,power quality,exposure control જરૂરી. Diagram detailed refining/cooling construction બતાવતું નથી.

h.en: 1.4.7 Cupola: continuous cast-iron melting furnace

body.en:
A cupola is a vertical shaft furnace using coke combustion and an air blast to melt descending iron charge. Metal/flux/coke additions and the operating coke bed are not just decorative layers.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A vertical steel shell with refractory lining forms the shaft and supports the heated charge column.
  2. A charging door admits measured layers of metallic charge, coke and suitable flux above the melting zone.
  3. The upper stack provides a path for rising hot gases; engineered gas cleaning/extraction controls emissions.
  4. A wind belt and tuyeres distribute the designed air blast into the coke-bed region around the furnace.
  5. The coke bed supplies fuel/thermal support, while flux assists slag formation from suitable impurities and ash.
  6. The well below tuyere level collects molten iron; the slag outlet is higher than the metal tapping outlet.
  7. Bottom/drop doors, supporting legs and tapping/slag-handling provisions complete the structure; their operation requires specialised controls.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified operators prepare and inspect the lined shaft, hearth/bottom arrangement, air supply and receiving system by the approved procedure.
  2. The furnace establishes its designed coke-bed and thermal condition under controlled specialised operation.
  3. Measured metallic charge, coke and flux are introduced through the charging door in the planned sequence.
  4. Air through tuyeres supports coke combustion; rising gases preheat charge and the hot zone melts the descending metal.
  5. Liquid iron moves downward into the well while slag forms and separates above it; melt chemistry/temperature are monitored.
  6. Metal and slag leave through their respective designed outlets, with replenished charge enabling continued melting during the campaign.
  7. Ending the campaign follows the specialised shutdown/bottom-handling and cooling procedure; lining and structural conditions are inspected before reuse.

Applications, limitations and safety

High output and comparatively economical cast-iron melting are advantages. Coke/metal interaction, sulphur pickup, composition control, refractory wear and emissions are limitations. Modern designs differ; no coke ratio, blast setting or tapping instruction is prescribed here.
body.gu:
Cupola vertical shaft માં coke combustion/air blast થી નીચે આવતા iron charge ને melt કરે. Metal/flux/coke અને operating coke bed ના functions અલગ છે.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Vertical steel shell/refractory shaft heated charge column રાખે.
  2. Charging door થી measured metal,coke,flux layers દાખલ થાય.
  3. Upper stack rising gases ને route આપે; engineered cleaning/extraction emissions control કરે.
  4. Wind belt/tuyeres coke-bed region માં designed air blast distribute કરે.
  5. Coke bed fuel/thermal support; flux impurities/ash સાથે slag formation માં મદદ કરે.
  6. Tuyeres નીચે well માં molten iron collect; slag outlet metal tap કરતાં ઉપર.
  7. Bottom/drop doors,legs,tapping/slag provisions specialised controls સાથે structure પૂરું કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified operators lining,hearth/bottom,air,receiving system approved રીતે inspect કરે.
  2. Controlled specialised operation થી designed coke-bed/thermal condition establish થાય.
  3. Planned sequence માં measured metal,coke,flux charging door થી ઉમેરાય.
  4. Tuyere air coke combustion આપે; rising gas preheat અને hot zone descending metal melt કરે.
  5. Iron well માં નીચે collect,slag ઉપર separate; temperature/chemistry monitor થાય.
  6. અલગ designed outlets થી metal/slag બહાર; replenished charge થી campaign દરમિયાન continued melting.
  7. Campaign ending માટે specialised shutdown/bottom handling/cooling; પછી lining/structure inspection.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

High output/economical cast-iron melting લાભ. Coke interaction,sulphur pickup,composition control,lining wear,emissions મર્યાદા. Modern designs અલગ; અહીં coke ratio,blast setting કે tapping operating instruction આપેલી નથી.

title.en: 1.5 Special casting processes: detailed construction and working
title.gu: 1.5 Special Casting: Detailed Construction અને Working

h.en: 1.5.1 True centrifugal casting: hollow cylindrical products
h.gu: 1.5.1 True Centrifugal Casting: Hollow Cylindrical Parts

body.en:
A rotating mould forces liquid metal toward its inner wall, forming a hollow cylindrical casting without a sand core for the bore in the true centrifugal method.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A strong cylindrical mould has a compatible inner surface/coating and the dimensions required for the intended pipe/tube.
  2. Rollers/bearings support the horizontal mould, or a spindle supports a vertical arrangement, according to the machine design.
  3. A controlled drive rotates the mould at its engineered speed; balance and alignment are essential for smooth rotation.
  4. End closures or retaining features limit axial escape of liquid in the selected product/mould arrangement.
  5. A pouring trough or delivery device introduces measured metal without contacting exposed rotating parts.
  6. Controlled mould cooling and any specified coating manage solidification and release; cooling must remain safely separated from metal.
  7. Enclosure/guards, speed monitoring and extraction/removal equipment protect against hot rotating metal and permit safe handling.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Authorised preparation verifies mould condition, retention, coating, rotation system and the specified metal quantity.
  2. The machine reaches its designed controlled rotational condition within its enclosure; no speed is inferred from this schematic.
  3. Metal is delivered through the designed feed arrangement while rotation distributes it around the circumference.
  4. Rotational action keeps liquid against the mould wall, establishing an outer shape controlled by the mould and an inner free surface.
  5. Heat extraction solidifies the wall progressively; rotation/control continue for the prescribed stage to retain shape.
  6. After sufficient solidification and controlled stopping/cooling, the casting is removed by the designed handling system.
  7. The bore/ends are cleaned or machined as specified; inspect wall thickness, concentricity and inner-surface inclusions/segregation.

Applications, limitations and safety

Pipes, liners and bushes are common uses. Good directional solidification and no central core are advantages; shape is restricted, equipment is specialised, and lighter impurities may concentrate toward the bore requiring machining. Semi-centrifugal casting makes solid rotational parts with feeding aided by rotation; centrifuging fills multiple off-axis cavities through runners—neither is the same hollow-pipe geometry.
body.gu:
Rotating mould liquid metal ને inner wall તરફ રાખે; true centrifugal method માં hollow cylindrical bore માટે sand core જરૂરી નથી.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Strong cylindrical mould ની compatible inner surface/coating અને required dimensions હોય.
  2. Horizontal type માં rollers/bearings,vertical માં spindle designed support આપે.
  3. Controlled drive engineered speed આપે; balance/alignment જરૂરી.
  4. End retaining features selected arrangement માં liquid ની axial escape રોકે.
  5. Pouring trough/delivery measured metal આપે,rotating parts ને touch કર્યા વગર.
  6. Controlled cooling/coating solidification/release manage કરે; cooling metal થી safely separated.
  7. Enclosure/guards,speed monitoring,removal equipment hot rotating hazards માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Mould,retention,coating,drive અને metal quantity authorised રીતે check.
  2. Enclosed machine designed controlled rotation પર પહોંચે; diagram પરથી speed ન નક્કી કરો.
  3. Designed feed થી metal આપતાં rotation circumference પર distribute કરે.
  4. Liquid mould wall સામે રહે; outer shape mould અને inner free surface બને.
  5. Heat extraction થી wall solidify; prescribed stage સુધી rotation/control રહે.
  6. Sufficient solidification અને controlled stop/cool પછી designed handling થી casting કાઢો.
  7. Bore/ends finish; thickness,concentricity,inner inclusions/segregation inspect કરો.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Pipes,liners,bushes માટે. No central core અને directional solidification લાભ; restricted shape/special equipment અને bore પાસે impurities મર્યાદા. Semi-centrifugal solid rotational parts માં feeding મદદ કરે; centrifuging off-axis multiple cavities ભરે. બંને hollow-pipe true method થી અલગ.

h.en: 1.5.2 Cold-chamber pressure die casting

body.en:
Metal melted in a separate furnace is ladled into a shot sleeve and driven by a plunger into a clamped reusable metal die. The injection unit is not continuously immersed in the bath.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A fixed die half and moving die half contain the cavity, parting interface and any designed movable cores/slides.
  2. The clamping mechanism holds the die closed against metal pressure; required clamp capacity depends on the shot and projected area.
  3. A shot sleeve receives a measured charge from an external ladle rather than a permanently submerged hot-chamber pump.
  4. A shot plunger and controlled drive force metal through the sleeve/nozzle connection into the die runner system.
  5. Runners, gates, overflow pockets and vents—or a designed vacuum system—manage filling and displaced air.
  6. Designed thermal-control channels maintain die temperature; leaking water into metal-contact areas is an unacceptable hazard.
  7. Ejector pins/plate and suitable handling remove the solid shot; guards and interlocks isolate the clamping/injection zones.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified setup verifies die condition, thermal controls, clamping, vents, ejection and the approved alloy/injection programme.
  2. The die is prepared and closed; its clamping system establishes the required designed restraint.
  3. A measured quantity of compatible molten alloy from the separate furnace is introduced into the shot sleeve.
  4. The controlled plunger stroke moves metal through runner/gate into the cavity while displaced gas leaves by the designed route.
  5. Pressure/control is maintained for the specified solidification stage; die heat extraction forms the casting.
  6. After safe solidification the die opens and the ejection system removes the casting together with attached runner/overflow material.
  7. The shot is trimmed and inspected, and the die/thermal state is prepared for the next guarded cycle.

Applications, limitations and safety

Common for aluminium alloys and other suitable alloys. High output, detail and finish are advantages; expensive dies, clamp/injection equipment, trapped gas and geometry limits are drawbacks. Conventional gas-containing die castings may not tolerate arbitrary welding/heat treatment; suitability depends on the process and alloy.
body.gu:
અલગ furnace નું molten metal shot sleeve માં ladle થાય; plunger clamped reusable metal die માં inject કરે. Injection unit continuously bath માં immersed નથી.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Fixed/moving die halves માં cavity,parting interface અને designed slides/cores હોય.
  2. Clamping metal pressure સામે die બંધ રાખે; capacity projected area/shot પર આધારિત.
  3. Shot sleeve external ladle થી measured charge લે,submerged pump નહિ.
  4. Controlled plunger sleeve થી runner system માં metal ધકેલે.
  5. Runners,gates,overflows,vents/vacuum filling અને displaced air manage કરે.
  6. Thermal-control channels die temperature જાળવે; leak hazardous છે.
  7. Ejector plate/pins અને handling solid shot કાઢે; guards/interlocks injection/clamp zone isolate કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified setup die,thermal controls,clamp,vents,ejection,alloy/programme verify કરે.
  2. Die prepare/close કરી designed clamp restraint establish થાય.
  3. અલગ furnace નું compatible measured melt shot sleeve માં આપે.
  4. Controlled plunger runner/gate થી cavity fill કરે; gas designed route થી નીકળે.
  5. Specified solidification stage સુધી pressure/control અને die heat extraction રહે.
  6. Safe solidification પછી die open અને ejector casting+runner/overflow કાઢે.
  7. Shot trim/inspect કરી die temperature/condition આગામી guarded cycle માટે તૈયાર.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Aluminium/અન્ય suitable alloys માટે common. Output,detail,finish લાભ; expensive dies/equipment,trapped gas,geometry limits મર્યાદા. Conventional gas-containing casting ને arbitrary weld/heat-treat ન કરવી; process/alloy suitability જોઈએ.

h.en: 1.5.3 Hot-chamber pressure die casting

body.en:
The injection cylinder/gooseneck is immersed in a holding bath, allowing repeated shots without separately ladling each charge into a cold sleeve.

Construction — 7 points

  1. A heated holding pot contains an alloy compatible with the immersed injection hardware.
  2. A submerged injection cylinder communicates with the metal bath through an inlet/port arrangement.
  3. A plunger moves in this cylinder and controls filling/isolation of the inlet during the designed injection stroke.
  4. A gooseneck passage carries the shot from the submerged cylinder to the die nozzle.
  5. A heated/temperature-controlled nozzle maintains the delivery path and seals against the die entry.
  6. Fixed/moving die halves, clamping, gates, vents and designed thermal control form and solidify the component.
  7. Ejector/handling devices plus electrical/thermal controls, guards and interlocks complete the automatic-cycle arrangement.

Working — 7 steps

  1. The approved alloy bath, submerged hardware, die condition and protective systems are brought to their qualified ready state.
  2. With the injection plunger in its filling position, molten metal enters the injection chamber through the designed inlet.
  3. The die closes and clamps, establishing the sealed filling cavity and its gas-escape route.
  4. The plunger advances, isolating the inlet and pushing metal through the gooseneck/nozzle into the die.
  5. Controlled pressure and die cooling support filling completion and solidification for the specified stage.
  6. The plunger returns, the die opens after sufficient solidification and the part is ejected by the designed mechanism.
  7. The shot is inspected/trimmed and the chamber refills for the next cycle while bath and nozzle conditions remain controlled.

Applications, limitations and safety

Often used for zinc and selected magnesium/other compatible alloy systems. Short cycles and repeated feeding are advantages. Immersed-hardware chemical/temperature limits are decisive: ordinary hot-chamber equipment is not a universal method for aluminium. Hot and cold chamber describe the injection arrangement, not whether the casting itself is hot or cold.
body.gu:
Injection cylinder/gooseneck holding bath માં immersed હોય; દરેક shot માટે separate cold sleeve ladling જરૂરી નથી.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Heated holding pot માં immersed hardware સાથે compatible alloy હોય.
  2. Submerged injection cylinder inlet/port થી bath સાથે communicate કરે.
  3. Plunger cylinder માં ચાલીને designed stroke દરમિયાન inlet isolate/fill કરે.
  4. Gooseneck cylinder થી nozzle સુધી shot લઈ જાય.
  5. Heated/controlled nozzle path જાળવી die entry સામે seal કરે.
  6. Die halves,clamp,gates,vents,thermal control component form/solidify કરે.
  7. Ejection/handling,controls,guards/interlocks automatic cycle પૂરું કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Approved alloy bath,submerged hardware,die,protection qualified ready state માં લાવો.
  2. Plunger filling position પર inlet મારફતે injection chamber માં metal આવે.
  3. Die close/clamp થઈ cavity/gas-escape route તૈયાર થાય.
  4. Plunger advance inlet isolate કરી gooseneck/nozzle થી metal inject કરે.
  5. Controlled pressure/die cooling specified stage સુધી filling/solidification આપે.
  6. Sufficient solidification પછી plunger return,die open,part eject થાય.
  7. Shot inspect/trim; chamber refill; bath/nozzle conditions controlled રહે.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Zinc અને selected magnesium/compatible systems માટે. Short cycles/repeated feeding લાભ. Immersed hardware ની chemical/temperature limits મહત્વની; ordinary hot chamber aluminium માટે universal નહિ. Hot/cold chamber injection arrangement છે, casting ગરમ/ઠંડી હોવાનો અર્થ નહિ.

h.en: 1.5.4 Investment casting: lost-wax ceramic-shell route

body.en:
A disposable wax pattern is invested in refractory ceramic. Removing the wax leaves a cavity; after metal solidifies, the ceramic is broken to recover the casting.

Construction — 7 points

  1. An expendable wax pattern reproduces the required casting shape with allowances suitable for wax tooling, shell and alloy behaviour.
  2. Wax runners/sprue connect patterns into a cluster or tree, providing a route for wax removal and later metal entry.
  3. A ceramic slurry system coats the pattern surface to form a fine refractory face layer.
  4. Refractory stucco and repeated coating/drying build shell thickness and handling strength around the complete cluster.
  5. A dewaxing provision removes the wax without leaving a reusable pattern inside the shell.
  6. A firing/preheating arrangement strengthens/conditions the ceramic shell according to the chosen shell system.
  7. A supported pouring station, metal supply and shell-breakout/cutting equipment complete the process; shell support depends on size and design.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Produce and inspect wax patterns, then assemble the accepted patterns onto the planned runner/sprue cluster.
  2. Coat the cluster with ceramic slurry and refractory stucco; repeat controlled drying/coating cycles to build the required shell.
  3. Remove wax through the specified dewax process while protecting the fragile shell from thermal/pressure damage.
  4. Fire and preheat/condition the empty shell according to the shell/alloy procedure; verify integrity and dryness.
  5. Introduce the specified melt into the supported shell by the selected gravity/vacuum/other approved filling arrangement.
  6. Allow adequate solidification/cooling, then remove the expendable shell and separate individual castings from the tree.
  7. Clean and inspect dimensions, surface and internal soundness; finish or heat-treat only as the alloy/product specification requires.

Applications, limitations and safety

Turbine components, precision hardware, medical/engineering parts and intricate alloy shapes are applications. Excellent detail and few parting-line constraints are advantages. Repeated expendable tooling, shell lead time, handling fragility and higher process cost limit suitability. “Lost wax” means the wax pattern is sacrificed, not dissolved metal.
body.gu:
Disposable wax pattern આસપાસ refractory ceramic shell બને. Wax કાઢતાં cavity મળે; metal solidify પછી ceramic તોડી casting મેળવીએ.

Construction — 7 points

  1. Expendable wax pattern માં shape અને wax/shell/alloy પ્રમાણે allowances હોય.
  2. Wax sprue/runners multiple patterns ને tree માં જોડે; wax removal/metal entry route આપે.
  3. Ceramic slurry fine refractory face coat બનાવે.
  4. Stucco અને repeated coat/dry થી shell thickness/strength બને.
  5. Dewax provision wax કાઢે; reusable pattern અંદર રહેતું નથી.
  6. Firing/preheat shell system મુજબ strengthen/condition કરે.
  7. Supported pouring,metal supply,shell-breakout/cutting equipment route પૂરું કરે; support size/design પર આધારિત.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Wax patterns બનાવી inspect કરો; accepted patterns runner/sprue tree પર assemble કરો.
  2. Ceramic slurry/stucco coat અને controlled dry cycles repeat કરી required shell બનાવો.
  3. Specified dewax process થી wax કાઢો; fragile shell ને thermal/pressure damage થી બચાવો.
  4. Empty shell fire/preheat/condition,integrity/dryness verify કરો.
  5. Supported shell માં selected approved gravity/vacuum route થી specified melt ભરો.
  6. Adequate solidify/cool પછી shell કાઢી tree માંથી castings અલગ કરો.
  7. Dimensions,surface,internal soundness inspect; alloy/product requirement મુજબ finish/heat treat.

Applications, limitations અને Safety

Turbine parts,precision hardware,medical/engineering complex shapes માટે. Detail અને fewer parting constraints લાભ. Expendable tooling,shell lead time,fragility,cost મર્યાદા. Lost wax એટલે wax pattern expend થાય, metal dissolve નહિ.

h.en: 1.5.5 Process selection: sand versus special casting
h.gu: 1.5.5 Process Selection: Sand સામે Special Casting

body.en:
Large low-quantity machine bed: sand casting can accommodate size and economical tooling. High-volume thin-walled suitable non-ferrous housing: pressure die casting may justify expensive tooling. Hollow cylindrical pipe/liner: true centrifugal casting avoids a bore core. Intricate precision alloy part: investment casting offers fine detail but longer expendable-shell preparation.

These are selection examples, not absolute rules. Check alloy, minimum wall, quantity, tolerances, internal passages, porosity acceptance, heat-treatment/weld requirements and tooling lead time. A high-production process is not automatically lowest cost for a single casting.
body.gu:
Large low-quantity machine bed માટે sand; high-volume suitable thin-wall non-ferrous housing માટે pressure die; hollow pipe/liner માટે true centrifugal; intricate precision alloy part માટે investment યોગ્ય હોઈ શકે.

આ examples છે,absolute rule નહિ. Alloy,wall,quantity,tolerance,passages,porosity,heat-treatment/weld needs,tooling lead time check કરો. High-production method single part માટે lowest cost હોવું જરૂરી નથી.

h.en: 1.6.1 Gas porosity, shrinkage cavities and inclusions
h.gu: 1.6.1 Gas Porosity, Shrinkage Cavities અને Inclusions

body.en:
Gas porosity/blowholes: gas becomes trapped or evolves during freezing. Causes can include excess moisture, poor permeability/venting, dissolved gas or turbulent filling. Effects include leakage and lower fatigue strength. Remedies depend on the cause: controlled sand/binder, dry charge, alloy-specific melt treatment and calmer vented filling.

Shrinkage cavities: inadequate feeding of solidification contraction, often at hot spots; improve feeder connection, directional solidification and section design, not merely pattern size. Slag/sand inclusions: dirty melt, erosion or broken mould/core material; improve cleanliness, strength and controlled gating. Similar-looking voids need diagnosis, not automatic attribution to moisture.
body.gu:
Gas porosity/blowholes trapped/evolved gas થી: moisture,poor permeability/venting,dissolved gas,turbulence શક્ય. Leakage/fatigue strength ઘટાડે. Actual cause મુજબ sand/binder control,dry charge,melt treatment,calmer filling.

Shrinkage cavity hot spots માં inadequate feeding થી; feeder/directional solidification/section સુધારો,pattern size માત્ર નહિ. Slag/sand inclusions dirty melt,erosion,broken mould/core થી; cleanliness,strength,gating સુધારો. દરેક void moisture થી જ છે એવું નહિ.

h.en: 1.6.2 Misrun, cold shut, mismatch, hot tear and surface defects
h.gu: 1.6.2 Misrun, Cold Shut, Mismatch, Hot Tear અને Surface Defects

body.en:
Misrun is incomplete filling; insufficient fluidity, thin/long passages or premature freezing may contribute. Cold shut is a weak seam where streams meet without proper fusion; improve filling path, metal condition and flow timing rather than blindly increasing temperature.

Mismatch/core shift causes stepped surfaces or unequal walls from poor location/support. Hot tearing is cracking during restrained contraction near the end of freezing; consider alloy/geometry, mould/core collapsibility and feeding. Metal penetration/burn-on and erosion damage finish; adjust sand/refractoriness/coating and flow conditions. Warpage distorts cooled shape; improve section balance, cooling and designed camber when justified.
body.gu:
Misrun incomplete filling: low fluidity,thin/long path,premature freeze કારણ. Cold shut બે streams proper fuse ન થતાં weak seam; filling path,metal condition,timing સુધારો,અંધાધૂંધ temperature નહિ.

Mismatch/core shift poor location/support થી stepped surface/unequal wall. Hot tear freezing અંતે restrained contraction crack; alloy/geometry,collapsibility,feeding જુઓ. Penetration/burn-on/erosion finish બગાડે; sand/refractoriness/coating/flow સુધારો. Warpage માટે section/cooling balance અને justified camber.

h.en: 1.6.3 Inspection and corrective-action sequence

body.en:
Inspect at stages: pattern dimensions and location; sand/core properties and integrity; closed mould preparation; melt condition; cleaned casting dimensions and surface. Use gauges/templates for geometry and the specified visual, leak or non-destructive tests for acceptance-critical defects.

Record defect type, position, frequency and associated process data. Form a probable cause, change a controlled variable and compare results rather than altering temperature, moisture and gating simultaneously. Internal defects may not be visible externally. Repair welding, impregnation or acceptance by concession requires the product specification and authorised approval; students must not assume every defect is repairable.
body.gu:
Stages મુજબ pattern dimensions/location,sand/core properties,mould preparation,melt condition અને cleaned casting geometry/surface inspect કરો. Specification મુજબ gauges,visual,leak,NDT tests લો.

Defect type,location,frequency,process data record કરો. Probable cause પરથી controlled variable બદલો,બધાં parameters એકસાથે નહિ. Internal defects બહાર દેખાય જ એવું નહિ. Repair welding/impregnation/acceptance માટે specification અને authorised approval જોઈએ; દરેક defect repairable નથી.

h.en: 1.6.4 Foundry safety: molten metal, dust, lifting and emergencies
h.gu: 1.6.4 Foundry Safety: Metal, Dust, Lifting અને Emergencies

body.en:
Keep charge, tools, ladles and receiving areas suitably dry and compatible: moisture can flash to steam on contact with molten metal. Reject sealed/unknown containers. Use specified foundry PPE, including appropriate face/eye protection, heat-resistant clothing and footwear arranged to avoid trapping metal; PPE does not replace barriers and training.

Control silica/binder fumes with suitable extraction and housekeeping; do not create airborne dust by dry sweeping or compressed-air cleaning. Use rated lifting gear and exclusion zones. Guard rotating/compacting machinery and isolate before maintenance. Keep routes clear and follow the site emergency plan. Do not pour water onto molten metal; raise the alarm, withdraw and let trained responders follow the appropriate emergency procedure.
body.gu:
Charge/tools/ladles/receiving areas dry અને compatible રાખો; moisture molten metal થી violent steam બની શકે. Sealed/unknown containers reject. Specified face/eye,heat clothing,footwear PPE લો; PPE barriers/training ને replace નથી કરતું.

Silica/binder fumes માટે extraction/housekeeping; dry sweeping/compressed air થી dust નહિ. Rated lifting/exclusion zones,guards,isolation જરૂરી. Routes clear/site emergency plan અનુસરો. Molten metal પર water ન રેડો; alarm,withdraw અને trained response.

title.en: 1.7 Pattern and casting cost estimation — solved examples
title.gu: 1.7 Pattern અને Casting Cost — Solved Examples

h.en: 1.7.1 Cost elements, yield and the denominator trap

body.en:
Pattern cost includes tool material, hardware, patternmaker labour, finishing and specified overheads. Casting cost includes net metal consumption/value, mould/core preparation, melting/energy, pouring, cleaning/fettling, inspection and allocated tooling/overheads. Selling price additionally includes the stated profit/tax basis; do not call every subtotal the selling price.

Casting yield=net accepted casting mass/poured metal mass. A5 kg casting with2 kg runners/risers has poured mass7 kg and yield5/7=71.43% before other losses. A20% loss of the initial charge means charge=required remaining mass/.80, not merely remaining mass×1.20. Always state whether a percentage is based on charge, net product, labour or total cost.
body.gu:
Pattern cost માં material,hardware,labour,finishing,overheads. Casting માં net metal,mould/core,melting/energy,pouring,cleaning,inspection,allocated tooling/overheads. Selling price માં specified profit/tax પણ; દરેક subtotal selling price નથી.

Yield=accepted net mass/poured mass.5kg casting+2kg runners/risers →7kg poured,yield71.43%. Initial charge નો20% loss હોય તો charge=remaining/.80,remaining×1.20 નહિ. Percentage base સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

h.en: 1.7.2 Solved pattern-making estimate with stated overhead base

body.en:
Given purchased wood volume.020 m³ at₹25,000/m³; hardware₹100; labour4 h at₹150/h; finishing₹100. Assume the purchased volume already includes cutting waste. Material=₹500; labour=₹600; direct cost=500+100+600+100=₹1300.

Overhead is specified as20% of LABOUR ONLY: .20×600=₹120. Production cost=₹1420. Profit is10% of production cost:₹142. Quoted price before tax=₹1562. Do not add a second wood-waste allowance or apply overhead to₹1300 when the question states labour only.
body.gu:
Wood purchase volume.020m³,rate₹25,000/m³→₹500; hardware₹100;labour4h×₹150=₹600;finishing₹100. Purchased volume માં cutting waste included. Direct=₹1300.

Overhead LABOUR ONLY ના20%=₹120;production₹1420. Profit production ના10%=₹142;before-tax quote₹1562. Waste ફરી ઉમેરશો નહિ;specified labour-only base ની જગ્યાએ direct cost પર overhead નહિ.

h.en: 1.7.3 Solved casting estimate: metal return and tooling allocation
h.gu: 1.7.3 Solved Casting Estimate: Return Credit અને Tooling

body.en:
Assume one5 kg net casting is poured with2 kg gates/risers, no extra melt loss, purchased charge at₹100/kg and a stated return credit₹50/kg for recovered gates/risers. Gross metal=7×100=₹700; return credit=2×50=₹100; net metal cost=₹600. No additional return credit is assumed.

Conversion costs: moulding₹150, melting/pouring₹80, cleaning₹50, inspection₹20 →₹300. Direct=₹900. Overhead20% of direct=₹180. Pattern₹4000 allocated over200 castings adds₹20 each. Unit production cost=₹1100 before profit/tax. These are illustrative given rates, not current market quotations.
body.gu:
5kg net casting+2kg gates/risers,extra melt loss નહિ. Purchase₹100/kg;specified recovered return credit₹50/kg. Gross7×100=₹700;credit2×50=₹100;net metal₹600. બીજો credit assume નહિ.

Moulding₹150,melting/pouring₹80,cleaning₹50,inspection₹20→₹300;direct₹900. Overhead direct ના20%=₹180. Pattern₹4000/200=₹20. Unit cost₹1100,before profit/tax. આ illustrative given rates,market quote નહિ.

h.en: 1.7.4 Loss and rejection examples: do not double-count

body.en:
If9 kg metal must remain after a stated10% charge-mass melt loss, initial charge=9/(1−.10)=10 kg. Here the loss is1 kg. If a different problem gives loss as10% of the FINAL mass, charge=9+.9=9.9 kg; the basis changes the answer.

If total spending is₹11,000 for10 attempted castings and one is rejected with NO salvage credit, cost per accepted casting=11000/9=₹1222.22. Dividing by10 gives cost per attempt, not per good casting. If salvage is explicitly given, deduct only that defined credit before dividing by accepted quantity. Returns, burn-off and rejection are different losses.
body.gu:
9kg remain જોઈએ અને charge-mass loss10% હોય તો initial9/.90=10kg,loss1kg. જો loss FINAL mass ના10% કહેલો હોય તો9+.9=9.9kg. Base બદલાતાં answer બદલાય.

10 attempts માટે total₹11000,એક reject અને NO salvage હોય તો accepted દીઠ11000/9=₹1222.22. /10 cost per attempt છે. Specified salvage હોય તો એ જ credit deduct કર્યા પછી accepted quantity થી divide. Returns,burn-off,rejection અલગ છે.

h.en: 1.8.1 Supervised practical: pattern, sand mould and report
h.gu: 1.8.1 Supervised Practical: Pattern, Sand Mould અને Report

body.en:
Syllabus practicals include preparing a pattern with allowances and a sand mould/casting; wax may replace molten metal for a demonstration when melting facilities are unavailable. Work only under instructor-approved conditions. A wax demonstration illustrates cavity filling but does not reproduce metal temperature, feeding, shrinkage or gas behaviour.
