Report: labelled component/pattern and mould sections; allowance calculations and stated basis; sand/core observations; gating/riser functions; sequence and authorised safety controls; observed result, dimensions and defect discussion. Mark unavailable observations as not performed. This package provides study material, not fabricated workshop evidence.
body.gu:
Syllabus practical માં allowances સાથે pattern અને sand mould/casting. Metal melting facility ન હોય તો demonstration માટે wax substitute શક્ય. Instructor-approved conditions જ. Wax cavity filling બતાવે પણ metal temperature,feeding,shrinkage,gas behaviour reproduce નથી કરતું.

Report માં labelled drawings,allowance calculation/base,sand/core observations,gating/riser functions,sequence/safety,result/dimensions/defects. ન કરેલું observation “not performed” લખો. આ notes fabricated practical evidence નથી.

q.en: What is casting?

a.en: Solidifying metal in a prepared cavity to obtain a required shape.
a.gu: Prepared cavity માં metal solidify કરીને required shape મેળવવી.

q.en: What are cope and drag?

a.en: Upper and lower parts of a split mould/flask.
a.gu: Split mould/flask ના upper અને lower parts.

q.en: What is a pattern?

a.en: Tool forming the mould cavity with necessary allowances/features.
a.gu: Allowances/features સાથે mould cavity બનાવતું tool.

q.en: Why use a split pattern?

a.en: To permit withdrawal and moulding of geometry difficult with one piece.
a.gu: One piece થી difficult geometry નું withdrawal/moulding સરળ કરવા.

q.en: What is draft?

a.en: Taper provided on withdrawal faces to reduce sand damage.
a.gu: Withdrawal faces પર sand damage ઘટાડતો taper.

q.en: Is shrinkage allowance always the same for every alloy?
q.gu: દરેક alloy નું shrinkage allowance same?

a.en: No; use the specified alloy/process contraction rule.
a.gu: ના;specific alloy/process rule લો.

q.en: Does machining stock enlarge a required as-cast hole?
q.gu: Machining stock થી as-cast hole મોટું થાય?

a.en: No; stock on its wall generally makes the as-cast hole smaller.
a.gu: ના;wall stock થી hole સામાન્ય રીતે નાનું થાય.

q.en: What is rapping allowance?

a.en: Usually a negative correction for cavity enlargement during loosening.
a.gu: Loosening cavity enlargement માટે સામાન્ય negative correction.

q.en: What is a core print?

a.en: Pattern feature forming a locating/support seat for a core.
a.gu: Core seat બનાવતું locating/support pattern feature.

q.en: When may a chaplet be needed?

a.en: When designed core-print support alone is insufficient.
a.gu: Designed print support એકલું insufficient હોય ત્યારે.

q.en: Does green sand mean green colour?

a.en: No; it means used moist and undried.
a.gu: ના;moist/undried condition.

q.en: What is permeability?

a.en: Ability of the sand mould to pass gases.
a.gu: Sand mould માંથી gas પસાર થવાની ક્ષમતા.

q.en: Why is collapsibility important?

a.en: It accommodates contraction and aids core/mould removal.
a.gu: Contraction accommodate અને removal સરળ કરે.

q.en: Function of the sprue well?

a.en: Reduces impact at the sprue-to-runner direction change.
a.gu: Sprue-runner direction change પર impact ઘટાડે.

q.en: Is a riser just a vent?

a.en: No; its principal purpose is feeding solidification contraction.
a.gu: ના;મુખ્ય હેતુ solidification contraction feed કરવાનો.

q.en: What areas define gating ratio?

a.en: Sprue:total runners:total ingates.
a.gu: Sprue:total runners:total ingates.

q.en: What is a squeeze moulding action?

a.en: Sand compaction by controlled pressure between head and supported tooling.
a.gu: Head/support tooling વચ્ચે controlled pressure થી sand compaction.

q.en: What separates metal from fuel gases in a crucible furnace?

a.en: The compatible crucible wall.
a.gu: Compatible crucible wall.

q.en: What defines a pit furnace?

a.en: Its heating chamber is largely below floor level.
a.gu: Chamber મોટાભાગે floor નીચે.

q.en: How does resistance heating differ from induction?

a.en: Elements heat indirectly in the shown resistance type; induced charge currents heat the induction charge.
a.gu: Shown resistance માં elements indirect heat આપે;induction માં induced charge currents.

q.en: Main use of cupola?

a.en: Continuous/campaign melting of cast iron in suitable foundries.
a.gu: Suitable foundries માં cast iron continuous/campaign melting.

q.en: Where does cupola metal collect?

a.en: In the well below tuyere level.
a.gu: Tuyere level નીચે well માં.

q.en: Does true centrifugal casting need a bore sand core?
q.gu: True centrifugal bore માટે sand core?

a.en: Normally no for the hollow cylindrical form.
a.gu: Hollow cylindrical form માટે સામાન્ય રીતે નહિ.

q.en: Hot versus cold chamber: main difference?

a.en: Immersed injection system versus separately ladled shot sleeve.
a.gu: Immersed injection system સામે separately ladled sleeve.

q.en: What is lost in lost-wax casting?

a.en: The disposable wax pattern is removed before metal filling.
a.gu: Disposable wax pattern metal filling પહેલાં કાઢાય.

q.en: Difference between misrun and cold shut?

a.en: Misrun is incomplete filling; cold shut is poor fusion at meeting streams.
a.gu: Misrun incomplete fill;Cold shut meeting streams ની poor fusion.

q.en: Can pattern shrinkage allowance cure an internal shrinkage cavity?
q.gu: Pattern allowance internal shrinkage cavity cure કરે?

a.en: No; feeding and solidification design must address it.
a.gu: ના;feeding/solidification design જોઈએ.

q.en: What is casting yield?

a.en: Net casting mass divided by poured mass, with the acceptance basis stated.
a.gu: Stated acceptance basis મુજબ net casting mass/poured mass.

q.en: Cost per good casting: divide by what?

a.en: Accepted quantity after applying specified credits.
a.gu: Specified credits પછી accepted quantity.

q.en: Why keep charge and tools dry?

a.en: Moisture can flash to steam violently near molten metal.
a.gu: Metal પાસે moisture violent steam બની શકે.
